'''Odin Nesloor''' was a [[human]] [[podracer]] [[Technician|mechanic]] with fair skin and [[Color|brown]] [[hair]].<ref name="VE" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, as depicted in [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']], to [[32 BBY]].</ref> Nesloor was in<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> the [[city]] of [[Mos Espa]]<ref name="VE" /> on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] during the build up to the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]].<ref name="TPM" />

Prior to the race, the mechanic was in the podracer [[hangar]]<ref name="TPM" /> of [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]]<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> working on the [[repulsorpod]] of the [[Podracer (profession)|podracer]] [[Gasgano]]'s<ref name="TPM" /> ''[[Ord Pedrovia]]''<ref name="CVD" /> vehicle when the local [[junk dealer]] [[Watto]] led the [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and the [[Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks]] into the [[hangar]]. After the race, Nesloor was sat on a crate in the hangar working on a device while the [[racer]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] celebrated his victory. While working,<ref name="TPM" /> Nelsoor wore a green [[Clothing|jumpsuit]] with a black vest and [[Limb|leg]] coverings, black [[boot]]s, a brown [[scarf]], black headgear, and black and silver ear defenders.<ref name="CVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Odin Nesloor appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Nelsoor was first identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="VE" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the [[Odin Nesloor/Legends|character]] was first identified on a card in the [[2001]] "[[Coruscant Limited]]" set released by [[Decipher]] for the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]''.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Odin Nesloor}}</ref>
